ouroboros.contracts.v1.ConnectGitHubSour.description: ConnectGitHubSourceSuccess returns the admitted connection and first snapshot.

connectionId.description: connection_id is the opaque admitted connection identity.

cursor.description: cursor is the opaque resume cursor after the first complete snapshot.

issueObjectCount.description: issue_object_count is the admitted issue evidence object count.

provider.description: provider is always github for this Stage 08 surface.

repositoryObjectCount.description: repository_object_count is the admitted repository evidence object count.

snapshotComplete.description: snapshot_complete is true only after a complete provider page set commits.

sourceScope.description: source_scope echoes the exact authorized scope.

state.description: state is READY or DEGRADED after the first snapshot attempt.
state.title: Connector Lifecycle State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.
